## Function Adopt Contract

The optional Adopter a Control may implement, and the one call the HTTP API and the MCP server make to it.

Behaviour: Declares in control/adopt.go, over the types of control/control.go (the Control interface itself is unchanged: 17 methods): `type Adopter interface { AdoptProject(ctx context.Context, name, dir, repoURL, language string) (ProjectView, error) }` (register a repository that already exists at dir — no init, no commit, no push), `var ErrUnsupported = errors.New("adopt not supported")` and `func Adopt(ctx context.Context, c Control, name, dir, repoURL, language string) (ProjectView, error)`: when c implements Adopter (a type assertion) → c.AdoptProject(ctx, name, dir, repoURL, language) returned as is (values and error); else (ProjectView{}, ErrUnsupported). ErrUnsupported is none of Code's sentinels, so Code(ErrUnsupported) is (500, "internal").

Steps:
- calls: Control Contract
- produces: ProjectView

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given c := a fake of the test file implementing the 17 methods of Control and `AdoptProject` (recording every AdoptProject call with its four string arguments; returning ProjectView{Name: "studio", Language: "go", RepoURL: "https://github.com/VasyaLutiy/MorphStudio", State: "idle", CreatedAt: 2026-10-10T18:00:00Z}, nil); Adopt(ctx, c, "studio", "/home/morph/MorphStudio", "https://github.com/VasyaLutiy/MorphStudio", "go"); when Adopt; then exactly that ProjectView, nil; the fake saw exactly one call AdoptProject("studio", "/home/morph/MorphStudio", "https://github.com/VasyaLutiy/MorphStudio", "go"); `var _ Adopter = c` compiles
2. given p := a second fake type of the test file implementing only the 17 methods of Control (no AdoptProject); Adopt(ctx, p, "studio", "/x", "https://github.com/o/r", "go"); when Adopt; then (ProjectView{}, ErrUnsupported) — errors.Is ErrUnsupported, err.Error() exactly "adopt not supported"; Code(ErrUnsupported) == (500, "internal")
3. given the fake of example 1 returning (ProjectView{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: bootstrap: refused: not a git repository: /home/morph/nowhere", ErrBadInput)); Adopt(ctx, c, "gamma", "/home/morph/nowhere", "https://github.com/o/gamma", "go"); then the fake returning (ProjectView{}, ErrExists) for Adopt(ctx, c, "demo", "/home/morph/demo", "https://github.com/o/demo", "python"); when Adopt; then an error errors.Is ErrBadInput with the text exactly "bad input: bootstrap: refused: not a git repository: /home/morph/nowhere" and Code → (400, "bad_input"); then errors.Is ErrExists and Code → (409, "exists"); the fake saw, in order, AdoptProject("gamma", "/home/morph/nowhere", "https://github.com/o/gamma", "go") then AdoptProject("demo", "/home/morph/demo", "https://github.com/o/demo", "python")

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Claude Behind An Interface: The claude CLI is reached only through claude.Process (stdin lines in, stdout lines out, an exit status); the daemon's tests use claude.Fake fed with lines from tests/fixtures/stream/probe.jsonl, never a real claude.
- Bearer Token On Every Route: Every HTTP route but GET /healthz and the MCP endpoints requires Authorization: Bearer <MORPHD_TOKEN>; /mcp and /mcp/{project} require the same token; /mcp/{project}/session requires that project's current session token. morphd listens on 127.0.0.1 only; TLS and the public name are Caddy's.
- The Session Reports Only Itself: A VPS session can call phase_done, wait_operator and milestone only through its own endpoint /mcp/{project}/session with the token morphd minted for that spawn; the token changes on every spawn, so a past session or another project cannot report.

Guardrails:
- Injected Clock And Ids: No package but cmd/morphd reads the clock or a random source: time comes in as a `now` argument or an injected Now func() time.Time, ids from an injected NewID func() string; time.Now, math/rand and crypto/rand appear only in cmd/morphd. Timers are the daemon's Tick, driven by main's ticker.
- No Network In Tests: Tests never open a listener or dial: HTTP is tested with httptest.NewRecorder and httptest.NewRequest, Telegram and GitHub through an injected Do, the MCP server over in-memory transports; a test writes files only under t.TempDir(); no test runs claude or reaches github.com or api.telegram.org.
- No Shell Outside Runner: os/exec is imported only by package runner (git, morph) and package claude (the claude process); every other package runs commands through runner.Runner and tests script them with runner.Fake.
- Secrets Never Logged: The API token, the session tokens, the GitHub token and the Telegram token never appear in a response body, a log line, a milestone, an error text or the argv of a spawned process; secrets live in files of mode 0600 under the state directory; the git credentials reach git through a credential store file, never through a URL or an argument.

## Function Event View

The compact, bounded view of session log entries a PM reads over MCP — type, short text, tool names, cost, exit.

Behaviour: Declares in control/events.go, exactly, one field per line: `type EventExit struct { Code int `json:"code"`; Stderr string `json:"stderr"` }`; `type EventView struct { Seq int64 `json:"seq"`; Dir string `json:"dir"`; Type string `json:"type"`; Subtype string `json:"subtype,omitempty"`; Text string `json:"text,omitempty"`; Tools []string `json:"tools,omitempty"`; CostUSD float64 `json:"cost_usd,omitempty"`; TerminalReason string `json:"terminal_reason,omitempty"`; Exit *EventExit `json:"exit,omitempty"` }`; `type EventsView struct { Events []EventView `json:"events"`; Last int64 `json:"last"` }`; `func Cut(s string, max int) string` (max <= 0 means 200; a string of at most max runes is returned as is, else its first max runes followed by one "…" (U+2026) — runes by unicode/utf8, never bytes); `func View(e eventlog.Entry, max int) EventView` and `func Views(e Events, max int) EventsView` (one View per entry in order, an empty non-nil slice when there is none; Last = e.Last). View: Seq and Dir are the entry's. Dir "exit" → Type "exit" and the Msg decoded (json.Unmarshal) into {"code": int, "stderr": string} → Exit = &EventExit{Code, Cut(stderr, max)}; a Msg that does not decode so → Exit nil. Any other Dir: ev, err := stream.Parse(e.Msg); err != nil → Type "raw", Text = Cut(the Msg decoded as a JSON string when it is one, else string(e.Msg), max); else Type = ev.Type, Subtype = ev.Subtype and, by ev.Type: "assistant" → Text = Cut(ev.Text, max), Tools = the "name" of every element of message.content with "type" "tool_use", in order (nil when none; the view decodes message.content itself — stream.Parse keeps no tool names); "user" → message.content a JSON string → Text = Cut(it, max); an array → Subtype = the "type" of its first element and, when that type is "text", Text = Cut(its "text", max) (a tool_result gives Text ""); "result" → Text = Cut(ev.Text, max), CostUSD = ev.Result.TotalCostUSD, TerminalReason = ev.Result.TerminalReason; "rate_limit_event" → Text = fmt.Sprintf("five_hour %d%% · seven_day %d%%", Percent(FiveHour.Utilization), Percent(SevenDay.Utilization)); "control_request" with Subtype "can_use_tool" → Tools = []string{ev.Tool} and, when ev.Question != nil, Text = Cut(ev.Question.Text, max); every other type and subtype → nothing more (Type and Subtype only). Unknown keys are ignored everywhere.

## Function Project Adopt

Check that an existing directory is the named GitHub repository on main with a record, and wire only the credential helper into it.

Behaviour: Declares in bootstrap/adopt.go, over the Report of bootstrap/create.go: `type AdoptSpec struct { Name string; Language string; RepoURL string; Dir string; CredentialsFile string }`, `var ErrRefused = errors.New("bootstrap: refused")` and `func Adopt(ctx context.Context, r runner.Runner, s AdoptSpec) (Report, error)`. Adopt never runs morph init, never commits, never pushes and never sets a git identity: the repository stays as it is. A refusal is fmt.Errorf("%w: <detail>", ErrRefused) (errors.Is ErrRefused; text "bootstrap: refused: <detail>"). Checks before any command, in this order, each a refusal with the Report empty (Steps nil): Name matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$ else detail `bad project name "<name>"`; Language is "typescript", "python" or "go" else `unknown language "<l>"`; github.Parse(RepoURL) ok else the detail is that error's text; filepath.IsAbs(Dir) else "dir must be absolute: <dir>"; os.Stat(Dir) is a directory else "not a directory: <dir>"; os.Stat(filepath.Join(Dir, "contour.yaml")) exists else "no contour.yaml in <dir>". Then the commands, each through r.Run in Dir with env []string{"GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0"}, in this order and with exactly these arguments; Report.Steps gets runner.Key(name, args...) of every command run, on failure too; a Run error of any command → (the report so far, "bootstrap: step <n>: " + err.Error()), never a refusal: 1. git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree: Code != 0 → refusal "not a git repository: <dir>" 2. git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD: Code != 0 → "bootstrap: step 2 failed (exit <code>): " + strings.TrimSpace(Stderr);
   strings.TrimSpace(Stdout) != "main" → refusal "on branch <b>, not main"
3. git remote get-url origin: Code != 0 → refusal "no origin remote"; else github.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(Stdout)) must
   give the same (owner, repo) as github.Parse(RepoURL) (so the ssh form, a ".git" suffix and a trailing "/" match) else
   refusal "origin <trimmed stdout> is not <RepoURL>" (an origin Parse cannot read gives the same refusal)
4. git config credential.helper "store --file=<CredentialsFile>" (one argument holding the space; git keeps the user's own
   helpers and adds this one): Code != 0 → "bootstrap: step 4 failed (exit <code>): " + strings.TrimSpace(Stderr)
Success → (Report{Dir: s.Dir, Steps: the four keys}, nil). The token is never an argument: the credentials file carries it, and FirstPush of bootstrap/create.go finds origin/main present on an adopted repository and pushes nothing.

Steps:
- calls: Project Create
- uses: runner
- uses: github
- produces: Report

1. given dir := t.TempDir() holding the file contour.yaml with the text "version: 1\n"; f := &runner.Fake{Script: {"git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree": {Stdout: "true\n"}, "git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD": {Stdout: "main\n"}, "git remote get-url origin": {Stdout: "https://github.com/o/demo.git\n"}}}; Adopt(ctx, f, AdoptSpec{Name: "demo", Language: "go", RepoURL: "https://github.com/o/demo", Dir: dir, CredentialsFile: "/st/demo/git-credentials"}); when Adopt; then error nil; exactly Report{Dir: dir, Steps: []string{"git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree", "git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD", "git remote get-url origin", "git config credential.helper store --file=/st/demo/git-credentials"}}; every one of the 4 Calls has Dir == dir and env exactly []string{"GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0"}; f.Calls[3].Args == ["config", "credential.helper", "store --file=/st/demo/git-credentials"]; no morph, init, commit, push or user.name call
2. given the runner of example 1 and the dir of example 1; in turn AdoptSpec{Name: "Demo", Language: "go", RepoURL: "https://github.com/o/demo", Dir: dir}; Name "demo" with Language "rust"; Language "go" with RepoURL "https://gitlab.com/o/r"; RepoURL ok with Dir "relative/demo"; Dir filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing"); Dir a fresh t.TempDir() without contour.yaml; when Adopt; then each an error errors.Is ErrRefused with the texts, in turn, exactly "bootstrap: refused: bad project name \"Demo\""; "bootstrap: refused: unknown language \"rust\""; "bootstrap: refused: github: not a github repository url: https://gitlab.com/o/r"; "bootstrap: refused: dir must be absolute: relative/demo"; "bootstrap: refused: not a directory: " + that path; "bootstrap: refused: no contour.yaml in " + that dir; every Report has Steps nil; the fake runner has no Calls

4. given the dir of example 1; the runner of example 1 but "git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD": {Stdout: "morph/20261010-084526\n"}; then instead {Code: 128, Stderr: "fatal: ambiguous argument\n"}; when Adopt; then errors.Is ErrRefused, text "bootstrap: refused: on branch morph/20261010-084526, not main", Report.Steps has 2 entries; then an error NOT errors.Is ErrRefused with the text "bootstrap: step 2 failed (exit 128): fatal: ambiguous argument", Steps 2 entries

- Claude Behind An Interface: The claude CLI is reached only through claude.Process (stdin lines in, stdout lines out, an exit status); the daemon's tests use claude.Fake fed with lines from tests/fixtures/stream/probe.jsonl, never a real claude.
- Bearer Token On Every Route: Every HTTP route but GET /healthz and the MCP endpoints requires Authorization: Bearer <MORPHD_TOKEN>; /mcp and /mcp/{project} require the same token; /mcp/{project}/session requires that project's current session token. morphd listens on 127.0.0.1 only; TLS and the public name are Caddy's.
- The Session Reports Only Itself: A VPS session can call phase_done, wait_operator and milestone only through its own endpoint /mcp/{project}/session with the token morphd minted for that spawn; the token changes on every spawn, so a past session or another project cannot report.

Guardrails:
- Injected Clock And Ids: No package but cmd/morphd reads the clock or a random source: time comes in as a `now` argument or an injected Now func() time.Time, ids from an injected NewID func() string; time.Now, math/rand and crypto/rand appear only in cmd/morphd. Timers are the daemon's Tick, driven by main's ticker.
- No Network In Tests: Tests never open a listener or dial: HTTP is tested with httptest.NewRecorder and httptest.NewRequest, Telegram and GitHub through an injected Do, the MCP server over in-memory transports; a test writes files only under t.TempDir(); no test runs claude or reaches github.com or api.telegram.org.
- No Shell Outside Runner: os/exec is imported only by package runner (git, morph) and package claude (the claude process); every other package runs commands through runner.Runner and tests script them with runner.Fake.
- Secrets Never Logged: The API token, the session tokens, the GitHub token and the Telegram token never appear in a response body, a log line, a milestone, an error text or the argv of a spawned process; secrets live in files of mode 0600 under the state directory; the git credentials reach git through a credential store file, never through a URL or an argument.

Status → 200 the Status. Events: query since (int64, default 0) and max (int, default 0); a non-integer → 400 bad_input with message "since must be an integer" / "max must be an integer"; → 200 the Events. Messages: {"text"} → Control.Order → 200 the OrderResult. Pending → 200 {"question":<Question or null>}. Answer: {"option"} → 200 {"ok":true}. Interrupt → 200 {"ok":true}. Usage → 200 the Usage. Restart: {"force"} (an empty body allowed: force false — the body is read only when Content-Length is not 0) → 200 {"ok":true}. Plan: a queue.Plan → 200 the QueueView. Continue → 200 {"ok":true}.
